**T-4 Bearing Seal Failure:** Turbine T-4 had its bearing seal corrode through, allowing seawater into the nacelle on 14 March 2025. The root cause was corrosion of the bearing seal housing, which caused a multi-week outage—the only such failure in the pilot.

**Energy Delivered:** 18.7 GWh over 24 months, 6% below the 19.9 GWh forecast.

**Budget Outcome:** Final cost was EUR 41.25 million against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million—an overrun of EUR 4.55 million (12.4%), driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign.

**Environmental Finding:** The independent fish-monitoring programme found no statistically significant change in migration counts before and after installation (p = 0.41).

**Recommendation:** Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing the titanium fastener set with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles, a change the steering group accepted in principle.

**Final Decision:** The steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026, contingent on a completed bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
